title: Home
meta_description: A strength gym for people who were not athletes. Classes capped at eight.
sections:
Start where you are

Coached strength training in groups of eight. No mirrors, no music you have to shout over.

8People in a class, maximum
3Coaches, all here every week
0Joining fees

Most people who train here had not lifted anything heavier than shopping when they started. That is the normal case, not the exception, and the first month is built around it.

Classes are capped at eight because past that nobody gets corrected, and being corrected is the entire point of paying for coaching.

1. Week 1

    An hour, one to one

    Before any class. We find out what moves badly and what hurts, and write the first month around it.

  2. Weeks 2–4

    Twice a week

    Same two slots each week. Same coach. Boring on purpose — boring is what works.

  3. After

    You pick the pace

    Two or three sessions, classes or open gym. Most people settle at two and stay for years.

First session is free

An hour with a coach, no obligation and no sales pitch at the end of it.

Book the first hour
